description: Sudan - State Boundary is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Boundaries", published or maintained by OCHA Sudan (World Bank Group). The datasets are curated from the The Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX). The Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) is an open platform for sharing data, launched in July 2014. The goal of HDX is to make humanitarian data easy to find and use for analysis. Coverage: Sudan. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Boundaries. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
